title: View default dashboard with initial dataset
description: Verifies the dashboard loads with the default dataset and initial visualizations render without any user interaction.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Verify sales charts are displayed
Verify a sales data table is displayed

title: Filter dashboard by one region and one product
description: Verifies selecting one region and one product updates charts and tables to reflect the filtered dataset consistently.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select a single option in the region multiselect
Select a single option in the product multiselect
Verify sales charts reflect the current region and product selections
Verify the sales table reflects the current region and product selections

title: Saved preset persists after app reload
description: Verifies a saved preset remains available after reloading the app and can be loaded to restore the previously saved filter set.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select multiple options in the region multiselect
Select multiple options in the product multiselect
Fill "Preset Persist" into the configuration name field
Click the save configuration control
Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select the saved preset "Preset Persist" from the preset selection control
Verify the region and product selections are restored to match the preset
Verify sales charts reflect the restored preset selections

title: Save a new filter preset successfully
description: Verifies a user can save the current region/product selections as a named preset and sees the Spanish success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select a single option in the region multiselect
Select a single option in the product multiselect
Fill "Preset A" into the configuration name field
Click the save configuration control
Verify a success confirmation is visible with the text "Configuración 'Preset A' guardada."

title: Filter dashboard by multiple regions and products
description: Verifies multi-selecting multiple regions and multiple products updates all visualizations and the table without desynchronization.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select multiple options in the region multiselect
Select multiple options in the product multiselect
Verify sales charts reflect the combined multi-region and multi-product selections
Verify the sales table reflects the combined multi-region and multi-product selections

title: Rapidly change filters keeps dashboard in sync
description: Verifies repeatedly changing region/product selections keeps charts and tables responsive and synchronized with the latest selections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select a single option in the region multiselect
Select a single option in the product multiselect
Change the region selection to a different option
Change the product selection to a different option
Verify all sales charts reflect the latest selections
Verify the sales table reflects the latest selections

title: Clear filters returns to default view semantics
description: Verifies clearing region and product selections returns the dashboard to the default (unfiltered) view as designed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select a single option in the region multiselect
Select a single option in the product multiselect
Clear all selections in the region multiselect
Clear all selections in the product multiselect
Verify sales charts match the default unfiltered view
Verify the sales table matches the default unfiltered view

title: Prevent saving preset with duplicate name
description: Verifies saving a preset name that already exists is prevented or results in clear feedback without creating a second conflicting preset.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select a single option in the region multiselect
Select a single option in the product multiselect
Fill "Preset Duplicate" into the configuration name field
Click the save configuration control
Fill "Preset Duplicate" into the configuration name field
Click the save configuration control
Verify a validation or error message is visible for the duplicate name
Verify only one preset entry exists for the name "Preset Duplicate" in the preset selection control

title: Prevent saving preset with blank name
description: Verifies attempting to save a preset with an empty or whitespace-only name is blocked with clear feedback and no success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Select a single option in the region multiselect
Select a single option in the product multiselect
Fill "   " into the configuration name field
Click the save configuration control
Verify a validation or error message is visible
Verify no success confirmation is visible
